data.name: Forest Guardians
data.fullDescription: Forest Guardians — a small tactical game about saving the forest from a spreading fire. You start with a single squirrel scout on a 10x10 top-down map, find the towns, hire a hedgehog or a turtle and use their water to put the fire out. Hold on for 25 turns and keep at least 3 of 5 towns. If a town burns before you reach it, you can never hire there again.
